Don't just clean your stains: obliterate them with the latest models from Automata Galactica!|An announcer during a [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] match|<ref name="Quesh Huttball">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=warzone|[[Arena of Death|Quesh Huttball Pit]]}}</ref>}}
'''Automata Galactica''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company that combined with [[Industrial Intelligence/Legends|Industrial Intelligence]] to form [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], one of the two most popular droid-producing companies.

==History==
Automata Galactica developed the [[ET-74 communications droid]] prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

On a specific day during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], all employees were forced to change their pass codes for the [[AG-network]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Slicing|Keyed Up}}</ref>
